description: PrizePicks lines (NBA, NFL, NHL, before the game) where the BetRivers or Kalshi price for the same player and stat moved materially while the PrizePicks line stayed. Each row has the line, the book move in probability points, when it moved, how long the line has stayed since, and observed_at for both sides. Information about prices, not a prediction or betting advice: say so when you relay it.

book.description: betrivers, kalshi or both comma-separated. Default both.

include_reverted.description: true also lists moves the book has since undone (book.still_moved false).

lookback_minutes.description: The move is measured against the value this many minutes earlier.

max_age_minutes.description: Only moves first seen within this many minutes.

min_move.description: Smallest move in the book over probability, in percentage points.

player.description: Case-insensitive substring of the PrizePicks player name.

stat.description: Exact PrizePicks stat name, case-insensitive, for example Points.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

name: get_stale_lines
title: Book moved, line did not
